```{python}
#| label: fig-mutual-inductance
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Reducing mutual coupling between bond wires (top view of a chip corner): the noisy output wire couples into the parallel sensitive wire via the mutual inductance $M$ (left); interposing a grounded $V_\\mathrm{SS}$ wire (middle) or arranging the wires perpendicular to each other at a corner (right) strongly reduces the coupling."

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle

fig, axs = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(8, 3.2))


def chip(ax):
    ax.add_patch(Rectangle((2.2, 0.2), 4.0, 4.0, fc='#6b7f95', ec='k',
                           lw=0.8))
    ax.text(4.2, 2.2, 'die', ha='center', fontsize=9, color='white')


# (a) coupled parallel wires
ax = axs[0]
chip(ax)
ax.plot([2.2, 0.4], [3.4, 3.9], 'r-', lw=1.6)
ax.plot([2.2, 0.4], [2.4, 2.6], 'b-', lw=1.6)
ax.text(0.3, 4.15, 'noisy', color='r', fontsize=8)
ax.text(0.3, 2.1, 'sensitive', color='b', fontsize=8)
ax.annotate('$M$', xy=(1.3, 3.15), fontsize=9)
ax.set_title('(a) parallel wires couple', fontsize=9)

# (b) interposed ground wire
ax = axs[1]
chip(ax)
ax.plot([2.2, 0.4], [3.6, 4.1], 'r-', lw=1.6)
ax.plot([2.2, 0.4], [2.9, 3.1], 'k-', lw=1.6)
ax.plot([2.2, 0.4], [2.1, 2.1], 'b-', lw=1.6)
ax.text(0.3, 4.35, 'noisy', color='r', fontsize=8)
ax.text(0.3, 3.3, '$V_\\mathrm{SS}$', fontsize=8)
ax.text(0.3, 1.6, 'sensitive', color='b', fontsize=8)
ax.set_title('(b) interposed ground wire', fontsize=9)

# (c) perpendicular wires
ax = axs[2]
chip(ax)
ax.plot([2.2, 0.4], [3.2, 3.2], 'r-', lw=1.6)
ax.plot([4.4, 4.4], [4.2, 6.0], 'b-', lw=1.6)
ax.text(0.3, 3.45, 'noisy', color='r', fontsize=8)
ax.text(4.6, 5.5, 'sensitive', color='b', fontsize=8)
ax.set_title('(c) perpendicular wires', fontsize=9)

for ax in axs:
    ax.set_xlim(0, 7)
    ax.set_ylim(0, 6.4)
    ax.set_aspect('equal')
    ax.axis('off')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
